# owner: platform
"""Tests for the parent absence notices."""

import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice, absent_days
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student

BRAM = Student("1003", "Thistle", "Bram", "A")


class AbsentDaysTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 1), "present"),
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absent_days(BRAM, marks),
            [date(2026, 9, 3), date(2026, 9, 5)]
        )

    def test_marks_for_another_student_refused(self):
        marks = [Mark("1004", date(2026, 9, 1), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absent_days(BRAM, marks)

    def test_no_absences_refused(self):
        marks = [Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 1), "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absent_days(BRAM, marks)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plural_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 1), "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks),
            "Bram Thistle missed 2 days: "
            "2026-09-01, 2026-09-05."
        )

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        marks = [Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks),
            "Bram Thistle missed 1 day: 2026-09-03."
        )

    def test_mixed_student_marks_refused(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1003", date(2026, 9, 1), "absent"),
            Mark("1004", date(2026, 9, 1), "absent")
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks)
